topic: Door Rear Right (RR) Lamp Control Commands and Parameters
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific command or parameter related to the control of the Door RR lamp, including fade speed, on/off status, color, brightness, and breathing rate.

column_semantics.Input: The source or method of input for the command (e.g., LIN bus, RHZCU module).
column_semantics.RHZCU: Right Hand Zone Central Unit, a vehicle control module.
column_semantics.DoorAmbtLampB_RR: Door Ambient Lamp B Right Rear, the target lamp being controlled.
column_semantics.RHZCU_LIN4: Specific LIN channel within the RHZCU.
column_semantics.内灯SSTS: Interior Lamp SSTS (Status, Signal, Test System), likely referring to internal testing or status monitoring.

core_entities.name: DoorRR2LampFadeSpdCmd_1_2_Spd2
core_entities.description: Controls the fade speed from current state to target state for the Door RR lamp. Default speed is 2000ms.

core_entities.name: DoorRR2LampOnOff_1
core_entities.description: Enables or disables the ambient light function of the Door RR lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorRR2LampColorCmd_1
core_entities.description: Sets the color of the Door RR lamp using RGB coordinates.

core_entities.name: DoorRR2LampBrtnsCmd_1
core_entities.description: Adjusts the brightness of the Door RR lamp as a percentage.

core_entities.name: DoorRR2LampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Configures the breathing rate of the Door RR lamp for a pulsing effect.

core_conditions.name: Input Source
core_conditions.description: Indicates whether the command is received via LIN bus or directly from the RHZCU module.

core_conditions.name: Command Value
core_conditions.description: The specific value sent to configure the lamp behavior (e.g., 0x00 for no request, 0x01-0xFF for various settings).

core_outputs.name: DoorAmbtLampB_RR
core_outputs.description: The actual state of the Door RR ambient lamp, including its color, brightness, and breathing pattern.

core_timing_constraints.name: Fade Speed
core_timing_constraints.description: The time required for the lamp to transition from its current state to the target state, with default and configurable speeds.

core_timing_constraints.name: Breathing Rate
core_timing_constraints.description: The frequency of the breathing effect, specified in rates from 0x01 to 0x0B.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the commands and parameters used to control the ambient lighting functions of the Door RR lamp, including its on/off state, color, brightness, and breathing effects. It serves as a reference for testing the correct implementation and response of the lamp to various control inputs from the vehicle's central unit.
